BiblicalUsage: Henadad is the name of a Levite whose sons are remembered for honest work on God's house. In Ezra they stand over the workmen of the house of God, and in Nehemiah his son Binnui repairs a stretch of the wall and is named again among the men who sealed the covenant.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that faithful work done quietly for God's house is never wasted, even when the only record of it is a name on a list.
